sources.title: KanameYOkoYAMA/2d-motion-interface · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: The interface captions human motion from 2D keypoints only — no 3D pose estimation anywhere in the pipeline. The pretrained motion-language model is frozen; only the 2D encoder (9.6M params) and the real-video adapter A_real (0.3M params) are trained.

sources.title: 2D Motion Interface - a Hugging Face Space by KanameYOkoYAMA
sources.snippet: 🕺 A Plug-and-Play 2D Motion Interface Captioning real monocular video through 2D keypoints only — no 3D pose estimation anywhere in the pipeline. The overlay shows the ViTPose 2D keypoints that are actually fed to the model. A_real is the .3M-parameter real-video adapter; the pretrained motion-language model is untouched.
